title: Smiling Woman with Wild Foliage in Forest, 1963 Nature B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
秋に入ります
ると紅葉を
こた「モエギ」が
彼女の地方に見
え始めます。皆様
は蒸らしてゐる
やうです。白く見える
のハ葉です
description: A July 1963 black-and-white snapshot depicting an older woman happily perched in a sunlit, rocky forest. Dressed in practical outdoor clothing and a sun hat, she holds a large wild mushroom in one hand and poses beside a bright, dense spray of leafy foliage. The date 'JUL • 63' is stamped on the top white border. On the back, handwritten Japanese text in purple ink poetically notes the changing of the seasons and the foliage visible in the picture.
